prompt.zh-TW: 綠茵運動用品去年與今年的每股盈餘都是 {{money:vars.eps}}，但本益比從去年的 {{number:vars.peLast|unit=times}} 變成今年的 {{number:vars.peThis|unit=times}}。最可能發生了什麼事？
prompt.en: Greenfield Sports had earnings per share of {{money:vars.eps}} both last year and this year, yet its P/E ratio moved from {{number:vars.peLast|unit=times}} last year to {{number:vars.peThis|unit=times}} this year. What most likely happened?

text.zh-TW: 股價上漲了，市場願意為同樣的每一元盈餘付更多錢
text.en: The share price rose, so the market now pays more for the same dollar of earnings

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。分母沒變、倍數變大，只能是分子（股價）變大。
feedback.en: That is right. With the denominator unchanged and the multiple higher, only the numerator, the share price, can have risen.

text.zh-TW: 公司今年賺得比去年多，所以倍數跟著變高
text.en: The company earned more this year, so the multiple rose

feedback.zh-TW: 倍數變高常常讓人聯想到「表現變好」，這個聯想很自然。但題目說每股盈餘兩年一樣，獲利並沒有變；變的是市場給的價格。
feedback.en: A higher multiple naturally suggests better performance. But the question says earnings per share were the same in both years, so profit did not change; what changed is the price the market pays.

text.zh-TW: 公司發行了更多股票，所以倍數變高了
text.en: The company issued more shares, which raised the multiple

feedback.zh-TW: 你想到股數會影響每股數字，方向正確。但股數變多會讓每股盈餘下降，而題目中的每股盈餘沒變，所以不是這個原因。
feedback.en: You are right that the share count affects per-share figures. But more shares would lower earnings per share, and here earnings per share did not change, so that is not the cause.

explanation.zh-TW: 本益比 ＝ 股價 ÷ 每股盈餘。{{option:o_k1w6}}是唯一能讓分母不變、倍數變大的解釋；{{option:o_m2x7}}與題目給的每股盈餘矛盾，{{option:o_n3y8}}會讓每股盈餘下降而不是不變。
explanation.en: P/E ratio = share price ÷ earnings per share. {{option:o_k1w6}} is the only explanation that leaves the denominator unchanged and raises the multiple; {{option:o_m2x7}} contradicts the given earnings per share, and {{option:o_n3y8}} would lower earnings per share rather than leave it unchanged.
